title: Demand to hand over or unlock the phone
officerCan: Seize a phone where the law authorises seizure, following the prescribed procedure and giving you a seizure memo.
officerCannot: Compel you to be a witness against yourself.
Take the phone without recording the seizure and giving you a copy of the list.

quotableLine.en: If the phone is being seized, please record it and give me the seizure memo. I am not able to give my password.
quotableLine.hi: अगर फ़ोन ज़ब्त किया जा रहा है, तो कृपया दर्ज कीजिए और ज़ब्ती मेमो दीजिए। मैं अपना पासवर्ड नहीं दे सकता।
quotableLine.ta: தொலைபேசி கைப்பற்றப்படுகிறது எனில், அதைப் பதிவு செய்து பறிமுதல் ஆவணத்தைத் தாருங்கள். என் கடவுச்சொல்லைத் தர இயலவில்லை.
quotableLine.te: ఫోన్‌ను స్వాధీనం చేసుకుంటున్నట్లయితే, దానిని నమోదు చేసి స్వాధీన పత్రం ఇవ్వండి. నా పాస్‌వర్డ్ ఇవ్వలేను.
quotableLine.bn: ফোন বাজেয়াপ্ত করা হলে, তা নথিভুক্ত করে বাজেয়াপ্তির কাগজ দিন। আমি পাসওয়ার্ড দিতে পারছি না।
quotableLine.mr: फोन जप्त केला जात असल्यास, त्याची नोंद करून जप्तीचा कागद द्या. मी पासवर्ड देऊ शकत नाही.
quotableLine.kn: ಫೋನ್ ವಶಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದರೆ, ಅದನ್ನು ದಾಖಲಿಸಿ ವಶ ಪತ್ರ ಕೊಡಿ. ನನ್ನ ಪಾಸ್‌ವರ್ಡ್ ಕೊಡಲು ಆಗುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ.

doNotSay: Anything about deleting or hiding files.
Any physical struggle over the handset.
documentNow: Whether a seizure memo was given, and the time the phone was taken.

options.label: Hand over the device if seizure is asserted, but do not supply the password.
options.rationale: Physical resistance is the greater risk; the password is the separate question.

options.label: Ask for the seizure memo.
options.rationale: Without it, there is no record the phone was ever taken.

options.label: Check that the session's evidence has already uploaded off the device.
options.rationale: Anything only on the phone is gone once the phone is gone.
